0.why: ONA::process reads only voltages[0] of this port; the manual states one octave of pitch for each volt applied, positive or negative

1.why: ONA::process reads only voltages[0] of this port through the FM attenuator; the manual says the FM mode switch makes it linear or exponential

2.why: ONA::process reads only voltages[0] of this port; the manual says an external waveform of ±5V resets the oscillator

3.why: ONA::process reads only voltages[0] of this port; the manual gives the pulse width control voltage range as 0 to 5V

comment: The maker's tooltip calls the FM knob an attenuverter and the hardware manual calls it an attenuator; the tooltip was followed. The maker's tooltips name the two mixed outputs Morph 1 and Morph 2, and the hardware manual calls the same two Complex 1 and Complex 2.
